content: Linear team-scoped data: workflow state IDs are per-team UUIDs; there is no global 'In Progress' id, you must query team.states and match by name or by type ('started'/'unstarted'/'completed'/'canceled'). Issue.branchName returns Linear's suggested branch name (team-identifier-number-slug, e.g. eng-4222-fix-login-bug). CommentCreateInput.parentId nests a comment as a threaded reply under a parent comment.
